channel.title: South Coast Business Awards 2018 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: Plans to create 'unique' SEN unit at former infant school site
item.description: An informal consultation will be launched to gather residents’ views on proposals to create a “unique” special educational needs (SEN) unit at the site of a former infant school in Lymington.

item.title: 'Why change things when it is not broken?' - Letter
item.description: It would appear now that the local surgery receptionist will become redundant, as no appointments can be booked via phone calls anymore and when you do attend you book in on a computer on the wall.

item.title: Thousands of bins to be delivered to residents ahead of collection changes
item.description: Thousands of bins will be delivered to homes in Fareham in the new year.

item.title: Three police officers in hospital a week before Christmas after 'shocking attacks'
item.description: Three police officers have ended up in hospital a week before Christmas after suffering “shocking” attacks.

item.title: Met Office reveals 'small chance' of white Christmas this year
item.description: The Met Office has revealed there is a "small chance" of a white Christmas this year.

item.title: Row over advertising screen as council says it could harm highway safety
item.description: An appeal has been launched over a digital advertising display which was refused as council planners believe it could distract drivers.

item.title: 'Huge milestone around the corner' for long-running M27 works
item.description: A major roadworks project that has caused delays to drivers for almost two years is nearing completion.

item.title: Two homeless hostels set to close after vital funding axed
item.description: Two hostels that provide temporary housing for homeless people are set to close with the loss of up to 18 jobs

item.title: Site earmarked for 17-storey block of flats put up for sale for £8m
item.description: The site of a former cooking oil processing plant which is earmarked to be transformed into a 17-storey tower has gone on sale for £8 million.

item.title: Dad feared Christmas crisis after Currys delivered two ovens with no plug
item.description: A father said he feared Christmas could be ruined after his new oven arrived without a working plug, leaving him with “unnecessary stress”.
